# RPC Errors — 406

Telegram RPC exceptions with code `406`. Each exception page includes its constructor, metadata, and source docstring.

| Exception | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| [`AllowPaymentRequired406`](exceptions/406/allow-payment-required406.md) | This peer only accepts paid messages: this error is only emitted for older layers without paid messages support, so the client must be updated in order to use paid messages. |
| [`AuthKeyDuplicated`](exceptions/406/auth-key-duplicated.md) | The same authorization key (session file) was used in more than one place simultaneously. You must delete your session file and log in again with your phone number or bot token |
| [`ChannelPrivate`](exceptions/406/channel-private.md) | The channel/supergroup is not accessible |
| [`ChannelTooLarge`](exceptions/406/channel-too-large.md) | Сhannel is too large to be deleted. Contact support for removal |
